name: Ohad
title: Son of Simeon
summary: Ohad was one of the sons of Simeon, who was a son of Jacob and Leah. He is mentioned in the genealogies in Genesis and Exodus as part of Simeon's descendants who went down to Egypt. Ohad plays no prominent individual role in the biblical narrative but is part of Israel's tribal history.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Simeon's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Ohad is listed as the third son of Simeon in the genealogy of Jacob's descendants.

keyEvents.title: Simeon's Sons in Exodus
keyEvents.description: Ohad is again mentioned among the sons of Simeon in the genealogy in Exodus.

keyEvents.title: Jacob's Family Travels to Egypt
keyEvents.description: Ohad was part of Jacob's extended family that went down to Egypt during the famine, where Joseph had already become a powerful leader.

keyEvents.title: The People of Israel in Egypt
keyEvents.description: As part of the tribe of Simeon, Ohad and his descendants settled in Egypt, where the Israelites eventually grew into a great nation.
